narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are five pairs and each pair has two factors, so thirty six has ten factors.
<bookmark mark='six'/>Look closely at six times six, because both partners in that pair are the same number.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Six is only one factor, so we must count it once and not twice.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>A square number has one factor that pairs with itself, so its count is odd.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Count the factors of sixteen, and find the factor that pairs with itself.
